ownership.quote: Cube Sandbox is a high-performance, out-of-the-box secure sandbox service built on RustVMM and KVM.

stage.note: CubeSandbox is an open-source project (Apache-2.0) published under the TencentCloud GitHub org; it is a product/open-source release of Tencent Cloud, not an independently funded startup. No separate funding rounds exist for this product.

note: CubeSandbox is an Apache-2.0 licensed, open-source AI agent sandbox project published by Tencent Cloud (TencentCloud GitHub org), part of Tencent Holdings Limited, a public company listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange (0700.HK). It is E2B-SDK compatible and built on RustVMM/KVM. As a product line of a large public company it has no independent funding history, accelerator participation, or standalone revenue disclosure; treat funding/stage fields as not applicable rather than a startup lacking data.
